page_numbering: physical PDF pages, one-based; printed pages 20–31
method: Each of the twelve original-resolution PNGs was opened individually through view_image(detail="original") and visually inspected. No contact sheet was used as evidence. Review covered diagrams, equations, captions, margins, flow, legibility, clipping and short orphan tails. This is layout review only, not a new theorem or proof audit.

findings.finding: A large float interrupts the proposition statement across the page break, before its final continuity clause and proof.
findings.recommendation: Relocate Figure 6.2 before Section 6.4 or after the complete Proposition 6.4 proof.
